$comment: Transcribed verbatim from the official NEC 'Civil Engineering Syllabus (ACiE)' PDF (5 pages) supplied with this project. Subchapter codes are the official NEC codes. Do not edit titles/details without checking against the source PDF.

exam.title: Registration Examination — Civil Engineering
exam.note: Chapters 1–4 are fundamentals/principles of concepts in civil engineering; chapters 5–9 are related to application of engineering principles in practice; and the last (10th) chapter is related to project planning, design and implementation.

subchapters.title: Engineering materials
subchapters.detail: Properties (physical, chemical, mechanical and thermal); types, characteristics, composition, selection, and usage/function of engineering materials (stones, bricks, tiles, cement, lime, timber, metals/alloys, paints/varnishes, and asphalt/bitumen/tar).

subchapters.title: Standards (NS & IS) and tests for civil engineering materials
subchapters.detail: Tests of brick (water absorption and compressive tests), tests of cement (consistency, setting time, soundness, and compressive strength); test of aggregate (bulking of sand); test of rebar (tensile test).

subchapters.title: Building technology
subchapters.detail: Building construction technology (brick and stone masonry, carpentry, painting, plastering, concrete roofing, flooring, damp proof course); Building by laws.

subchapters.title: Geometric properties of sections
subchapters.detail: Axes of symmetry; centre of gravity of different sections (e.g., built-up plane figures, standard steel sections); moment of inertia; radius of gyration.

subchapters.title: Surveying and levelling
subchapters.detail: Fundamentals of surveying; measurements (linear distance, vertical distance, and angle and directions); levelling; topographic survey (principles and applications); Simple circular curves, principles and applications of GPS/GIS.

subchapters.title: Estimating, costing, and valuation
subchapters.detail: Types of estimate; methods of estimating; rate analysis; specifications (purpose, importance and types), valuation.

subchapters.title: Soil properties and laboratory tests
subchapters.detail: Tests for strength, permeability, compressibility, phase relationships; determination of index and engineering properties of soils; soil classification (descriptive, textural, ISI, MIT, USCS); boring log interpretation; sieve analysis and interpretation of results; determination of Atterberg limits of soils.

subchapters.title: Stresses on soil and seepage
subchapters.detail: Effective stress (factors affecting effective stress, capillary rise, and quick sand conditions); seepage analysis [Seepage pressure, flow nets and their applications]; soil compressibility (including various indices) and compaction (definition, affecting factors).

subchapters.title: Shear strength of soil and stability of slopes
subchapters.detail: Concept of shear strength, principal planes and principal stresses; Mohr-Coulomb theory of shear strength; calculation of normal and shear stresses at different planes; relation of principle stress at failure condition; types of shear tests; stability of slopes.

subchapters.title: Soil exploration, earth pressure and retaining structures
subchapters.detail: Soil exploration (methods, planning, soil sampling and samplers, field tests, site investigation reports); earth pressure theories; stability analysis of retaining walls; techniques to increase stability of retaining walls.

subchapters.title: Fundamentals of foundation
subchapters.detail: Definition, Types (Shallow and Deep), functions, factor affecting, site investigation of foundation, concept of spread and mat foundation.

subchapters.title: Bearing capacity and foundation settlements
subchapters.detail: Bearing capacity (types, effects of various factors); modes of foundation failure; Terzaghi's general bearing capacity theory; ultimate bearing capacity of cohesion-less and cohesive soils; consolidation (concept, types and tests); settlement (types, nature, effects and calculations).

subchapters.title: Fluids and their properties
subchapters.detail: Types of fluids; fluid properties (mass density, specific weight, specific gravity, specific volume, viscosity, compressibility, capillarity, surface tension, cavitation and vapour pressure).

subchapters.title: Hydrostatics
subchapters.detail: Pressure and head; Pascal's law; pressure-depth relationship; manometers; pressure force and centre of pressure on submerged bodies (plane and curved surfaces, practical applications); pressure diagrams; buoyancy; stability of floating/submerged bodies.

subchapters.title: Hydro-kinematics and hydro-dynamics
subchapters.detail: Classification of fluid flow; conservation of mass (continuity equation) and momentum equations and their applications; Bernoulli's equation and its application; flow measurement.

subchapters.title: Pipe flow
subchapters.detail: Types, governing equations, major and minor head losses; HGL and TEL lines; design; pipe network problems; unsteady flow in pipes and relief devices.

subchapters.title: Open channel flow
subchapters.detail: Geometrical properties; various types of flows; energy and momentum principles (Specific Energy and Specific Force); Types of gradually varied flow profiles; hydraulic jump (types, theory for horizontal and rectangular); flow in mobile boundary channel (design principles/approaches; inception motion condition; Shield diagram).

subchapters.title: Hydrology
subchapters.detail: Hydrologic cycle and water balance components; flow measurement and rating curves; hydrographs analysis and synthetic unit hydrographs; rainfall-runoff analysis; flood hydrology (flood frequency analysis and design flood); groundwater hydrology.

subchapters.title: Shear forces and bending moments
subchapters.detail: Axial forces, shear forces, and bending moments; loads and load superposition; relationship and diagram Interpretation (AF, SF, BM).

subchapters.title: Stress and strain analysis
subchapters.detail: Normal and shear stresses; principal stresses and principal planes; maximum shear stress and corresponding plane; stress-strain curves; torsion.

subchapters.title: Theory of flexure and columns
subchapters.detail: Co-planar and pure bending; elastic curve; angle of rotation; radius of curvature and flexural stiffness; deflection; bending stress; Euler's formula for long column.

subchapters.title: Determinate structures-1
subchapters.detail: Degree of determinacy, Energy Methods, Virtual Work Method, Deflection of beams and portal frame.

subchapters.title: Determinate structures-2
subchapters.detail: Influence Lines for Simple Structures with point loads and UDL; analysis of two hinged arches.

subchapters.title: Indeterminate structures
subchapters.detail: Flexibility Method, Two-Hinged Parabolic Arches, Slope Deflection Method, Moment Distribution Method, Stiffness method, Influence Lines for Continuous Beams, Elementary Plastic analysis.

subchapters.title: Loads and load combinations
subchapters.detail: Dead Load, Imposed Load, Wind Load, Snow Load, Earthquake Load.

subchapters.title: Concrete technology
subchapters.detail: Concrete technology (materials, properties, mix design, testing, quality control, and codes (IS and NS)).

subchapters.title: RCC structures-1
subchapters.detail: Working stress and limit state methods; design of beams and slabs; analysis of RC beams and slabs in bending, shear, deflection, bond and end anchorage; RCC; NS & IS codes.

subchapters.title: RCC structures-2
subchapters.detail: Design of columns and isolated/combined footings; pre-stressed concrete; NS & IS codes.

subchapters.title: Steel structures
subchapters.detail: Standard and built-up sections; design of bolted and welded connections; design of simple elements such as ties, struts, axially loaded columns, and column bases; NS and IS codes.

subchapters.title: Timber and masonry structures
subchapters.detail: Design principles of timber beams and columns; Design of masonry structures (Mandatory rules of thumb, Nepal Building Code (NBC), properties), Failure modes of masonry structure, mud mortar, lime mortar and cement mortar and its properties.

subchapters.title: Water sources, water quality and water demand
subchapters.detail: Sources of water (surface and groundwater) and their selection; impurities in water (suspended, colloidal, dissolved); hardness and alkalinity; living organisms in water; water-related diseases and prevention measures; drinking water quality standards; water demand estimation.

subchapters.title: Intake and distribution systems
subchapters.detail: Types of intakes, factor affecting while selection of location of intake; types and purposes of pipe materials, joints, valves and fittings; break pressure tanks; service reservoirs and their capacity determination; design of branch and looped water distribution systems.

subchapters.title: Water treatment process and technologies
subchapters.detail: Various treatment process and their purposes; screening; plain sedimentation; sedimentation with coagulation; flocculation; filtration; disinfection; softening; and miscellaneous treatments (aeration, removal of iron and manganese, removal of color/odour/taste).

subchapters.title: Design and construction of sewers
subchapters.detail: Estimation of quantity of waste water; sewerage system and types; design criteria of sewers; shapes of sewers; sewer materials; design of sewers for separate and combined systems; construction of sewers and sewer appurtenances.

subchapters.title: Treatment and disposal of wastewater
subchapters.detail: Characteristics and examination of sewage; decomposition of wastewater; BOD and COD; primary treatment processes and design of grit chamber; secondary or biological treatment process; sewage filtration; activated sludge process; oxidation ponds; waste water disposal by dilution (oxygen sag curve; Streeter Phelp's equation); waste water disposal by land treatment; sludge and solid waste disposal methods; latrine and septic tank.

subchapters.title: Concept of environmental assessment
subchapters.detail: BES; IEE; EIA; government's act, rules/regulations/procedures for BES/IEE/EIA; Types of disaster and its mitigation.

subchapters.title: Water demand estimation
subchapters.detail: Crop water and irrigation water requirements; water availability for irrigation; command areas; irrigation intensity; duty, delta and their relationship; water losses and irrigation efficiencies; effective rainfall; soil-moisture-irrigation relationship; depth and frequency of irrigation; design discharge for canals.

subchapters.title: Design of canals
subchapters.detail: Canal types, network and alignment; tractive force approach of canal design; design of stable canals, alluvial canals (Kennedy's and Lacey's theory), and lined canals.

subchapters.title: Diversion headworks
subchapters.detail: Components of headwork; seepage theories and their applications (Bligh's, Lane's, Khosla's); design of silt control structures (excluder, ejector and settling basins); design of weir/barrage (crest, length and thickness of impervious floor); design of energy dissipaters.

subchapters.title: River training works
subchapters.detail: River stages and need of river training; design of river training works (guide bund and launching aprons, levees and spurs); watershed management.

subchapters.title: Regulating and cross-drainage structures
subchapters.detail: Functions of various types of regulators, design of regulators and escapes (crest, length and thickness of impervious floor); design of pipe outlet (free and submerged); design of vertical drop (crest, length, and thickness of impervious floor); design of cross-drainage structures.

subchapters.title: Water logging and drainage
subchapters.detail: Causes, effects and preventive measures; design of surface and sub-surface drainage systems.

subchapters.title: Planning of hydropower projects
subchapters.detail: Power potential (gross, technical, economic) of Nepal and the world; stages of hydropower development, hydropower development in Nepal (history, policy, acts & regulation).

subchapters.title: Power and energy potential study
subchapters.detail: Power and energy potentials; methods of fixing installed capacity of a plant; types of hydropower plants on various basis; components of different types of hydropower projects; reservoirs and their regulation.

subchapters.title: Headworks of storage plants
subchapters.detail: Components of a typical storage plant; dams (types, functions, selection, design, failure modes and remedies); stability analysis of gravity dam, seepage control and foundation treatment in dams; design of intake, spillway and energy dissipaters; gates (types and locations).

subchapters.title: Headworks of run-of-river (ROR) plants
subchapters.detail: Components of a typical ROR plant; design of intake; methods of bed and suspended load handling; design of settling basin (practice and concentration approach), estimation of sediment volume in settling basin, flushing of deposited sediment, estimation of flushing frequency for sediments.

subchapters.title: Water conveyance structures
subchapters.detail: Hydraulic tunnels, x-sections, and hydraulic design (velocity and sizing); tunnel lining; design of forebay and surge tanks; design of penstocks and pressure shaft; hydraulic transients (water hammer).

subchapters.title: Hydro-electric machines and powerhouse
subchapters.detail: Hydro-mechanical equipment and their functions; types of turbines and performance characteristics; selection of turbine and their specific speed; preliminary design of Francis and Pelton turbines; scroll case and draft tubes; generators (types, rating); governs; pumps and their performance characteristics; powerhouse (types, general arrangements, dimensions).

subchapters.title: Highway planning and survey
subchapters.detail: Modes of transport, history of road development in Nepal; classification of roads; road survey; highway alignment and controlling factors; evaluating alternate alignments; Road Standards of Nepal.

subchapters.title: Geometric design of highway
subchapters.detail: Basic design control and criteria; elements of highway cross-section; highway curves; super elevation; average and ruling gradients; stopping sight distance; design considerations for horizontal and vertical alignments, extra widening, and set back distance; design of road drainage structures; design considerations for hill roads.

subchapters.title: Highway materials
subchapters.detail: Types of aggregates and tests on their gradation, strength, durability; binding materials and their tests; design of asphalt mixes; evaluation of subgrade soil.

subchapters.title: Traffic engineering and safety
subchapters.detail: Impact of human and vehicular characteristics on traffic planning; traffic operations and regulations; traffic control devices; traffic studies (volume, speed, O&D, traffic capacity, traffic flow characteristics, parking, accident, flow); road intersections (types, configurations, design); traffic lights; factors influencing night visibility, road safety measures.

subchapters.title: Road pavement
subchapters.detail: Different types of pavement; design methods for flexible and rigid pavements (DOR Guidelines); loads and other factors controlling pavement design; stress due to load, temperature.

subchapters.title: Road construction & maintenance
subchapters.detail: Activities, techniques, tools, equipment and plants used in road construction; preparation of road subgrade; field compaction control and soil stabilization; construction of asphalt concrete layers; construction procedure for penetration macadam, bituminous bound macadam and plain cement concrete pavements; road maintenance, repair and rehabilitation.

subchapters.title: Engineering drawings and its concepts
subchapters.detail: Fundamentals of standard drawing sheets, dimensions, scale, line diagram, orthographic projection, isometric projection/view, pictorial views, and sectional drawing.

subchapters.title: Engineering Economics
subchapters.detail: Understanding of project cash flow; discount rate, interest and time value of money; basic methodologies for engineering economics analysis (Discounted Payback Period, NPV, IRR & MARR); comparison of alternatives, depreciation system and taxation system in Nepal.

subchapters.title: Project planning and scheduling
subchapters.detail: Project classifications; project life cycle phases; project planning process; project scheduling (bar chart, CPM, PERT); resources levelling and smoothing; monitoring/evaluation/controlling.

subchapters.title: Project management
subchapters.detail: Information system; project risk analysis and management; project financing, tender and its process, and contract management.

subchapters.title: Engineering professional practice
subchapters.detail: Environment and society; professional ethics; regulatory environment; contemporary issues/problems in engineering; occupational health and safety; roles/responsibilities of Nepal Engineers Association (NEA).

subchapters.title: Engineering Regulatory Body
subchapters.detail: Nepal Engineering Council (Acts & Regulations).
